plainText:
Goh's Pinsir (Japanese: ゴウのカイロス Go's Kailios) is the seventh that Goh in the Kanto region, and his eighth overall.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
In Working My Way Back to Mew!, Goh encountered Pinsir in Vermilion Forest while he was preparing to catch himself a . Pinsir startled and and began to attack. Scared, Goh started throwing things at Pinsir, eventually throwing a at it, causing it to be caught by Goh. It was later seen with Goh's other Pokémon when Professor Cerise offered it a place in the Cerise Laboratory.

In Panic in the Park!, Pinsir tries to calm down some of Goh's other Pokémon while they started to argue. When loses control, Pinsir joins the other Pokémon to help Goh's three evolve safely.

In Trade, Borrow, and Steal!, Goh met a girl named Kricketina Kylie, who wanted to trade Pinsir for one of her Pokémon, something that Goh was reluctant to do. Goh offered to help Kricketina find a Pinsir of her own which they agreed to do. When Goh later caught another Pinsir, he traded it for Kricketina's as his Pinsir had fallen in love with it.

In Suffering the Flings and Arrows!, Goh's newly caught released a sweet aroma that caused Heracross to fall in love with her, leading Pinsir to grow depressed. Wanting to help Pinsir, Ash and Goh took it to the Celadon Gym, where Erika was hosting Pokémon Flower Arrangement. Goh decorated Pinsir with a flowery dress so that it could impress Heracross, but just when he called out Heracross, attacked the Gym. During the battle against them, Pinsir shielded Heracross from a before sending the villainous trio blasting off, earning back Heracross's love and admiration.

In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Pinsir attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.
 

===Personality and characteristics===
 
Pinsir is a timid who doesn't like to fight, as seen in Serving Up the Flute Cup! when Goh was considering which of his team to use in the Battle Frontier Flute Cup, Pinsir avoided being chosen. This was seen again in Trade, Borrow, and Steal! when Goh was left to battle , Pinsir hid behind a tree, not wishing to battle. It has often been seen with Goh's smaller Pokémon, such as . When it is startled or uncomfortable it will often cower behind Goh or an object like a tree. Goh is generally accommodating to Pinsir's personality, and while he sometimes asks Pinsir if it is up for a battle, he never pressures it into battling against its will.

Pinsir doesn't seem to like conflict as it was seen trying to prevent Goh's Grimer for getting aggressive over the food shortage in Panic in the Park!, as well as attempting to help the other Pokémon that Grimer was blaming. It loves picking flowers and can be playful with others of the lab.

In Trade, Borrow, and Steal!, Pinsir developed a crush on Heracross, which motivated Goh to trade his second Pinsir for Heracross so that they may be together. Pinsir's love for Heracross is so strong that it became depressed when it saw Heracross falling in love with Goh's newly caught . This continued in Big Brother to the Rescue!, and when and appeared to have sorted out the conflict, Heracross became attracted by 's smell, leading Pinsir to become furious and attack Heracross.

==In the games==
===Pokémon GO===
On November 6, 2020, as part of Pokémon GO's Animation Week 2020 event, which was based on , several Pokémon based on those that Ash and Goh encountered in the Journeys series appeared more frequently in the wild, in s, from 7 km Eggs, and during surprise encounters, with Pinsir appearing only in level 3 raids. The event ran from November 6, 2020, at 8:00 a.m., to November 12, 2020, at 10:00 p.m. local time.

==In the manga==
 
===Pokémon Journeys===
Pinsir debuted in Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!.
 

==Trivia==
Pinsir is Goh's first Pokémon to not be part of an evolutionary line.
